zufolge.en: according to, according to (postponed with date)

bloques.titulo: Forms for indicating the source of information
texto: In order to cite sources with accuracy without assuming its conclusions as its own facts, the German has specific prepositional constructions:
1. **laut + Dat./Gen.**: **Laut dem Umweltamt seien die Emissionen gesunken** (according to the Environment Agency...).
2. **nach Angaben + Gen./von**: **Nach Angaben unabhängiger Experten gebe es Fortschritte** (according to independent expert statements...).
3. **... zufolge (pospuesto con dativo)**: **Neuesten Berichten zufolge habe der Konzern investiert** (according to the latest reports...).
These formulas are often combined with the Konjunktiv I to strengthen the journalistic distance.

filas: Laut der Sprecherin gebe es Einigung.
Nach Angaben des Ministeriums sei alles ruhig.
Den Medien zufolge seien die Zahlen positiv.

frases.de: Laut dem Umweltamt seien die Emissionen im letzten Jahr gesunken.
frases.es: Según la Agencia de Medio Ambiente, las emisiones habrían bajado el último año.
frases.en: According to the Environment Agency, the emissions would have dropped the last year.

frases.de: Nach Angaben unabhängiger Forscher gebe es jedoch regionale Unterschiede.
frases.es: Según datos de investigadores independientes, habría no obstante diferencias regionales.
frases.en: According to data from independent researchers, there would nevertheless be regional differences.
analisis: according to data from independent researchers

frases.de: Den neuesten Berichten zufolge sei die Solarenergie stark ausgebaut worden.
frases.es: Según los últimos informes, la energía solar se habría ampliado notablemente.
frases.en: According to the latest reports, solar energy would have expanded significantly.
analisis: the solar energy would have been

frases.de: Wir müssen im Artikel immer deutlich Quelle und Aussage trennen.
frases.es: En el artículo siempre debemos separar con claridad la fuente y la afirmación.
frases.en: In the article we must always clearly separate the source and the affirmation.

bloques.pregunta: What is the most common position of the word «zufolge» when the source is indicated?

opciones.texto: Detrás del sustantivo al que complementa, rigiendo dativo.
opciones.explicacion: «Den Berichten zufolge» is typically built as a dative postposition.

opciones.texto: In front of the conjugated verb at the absolute beginning of prayer.
opciones.explicacion: It is placed behind the nominal group representing the source.

opciones.texto: Always at the end of the subordinate as if it were a separable prefix.
opciones.explicacion: It's a source adposition, not a separable verbal particle.

bloques.frase: Laut dem Sprecher des Ministeriums ___ der Plan fristgerecht umgesetzt.

opciones.explicacion: Konjunktiv I of «werden» to indicate a future forecast in related discourse.
It is indicative; the journalistic distance uses the Konjunktiv.
It is passed from indicative; it alters the time to the preterito.

bloques.frase: Nach Angaben unabhängiger Forscher gebe es erhebliche Unterschiede.

opciones.texto: Que, según declaraciones de investigadores independientes, existen diferencias notables.
opciones.explicacion: «Nach Angaben» introduces the source and «gebe es» refers to the claim in Konjunktiv I.

opciones.texto: That independent researchers deny having conducted studies in the region.
opciones.explicacion: The phrase states that they provide specific data («Nach Angaben...»).

opciones.texto: That the government has banned the publication of environmental reports.
opciones.explicacion: No official prohibition is mentioned, but there are disparities.

bloques.pregunta: What case does the «laut» preposition usually govern in the modern formal language?

opciones.explicacion: In modern German it is widely used with dativa («laut dem Bericht») and also with genius.
«Laut» expresses reference source, not direction or movement in accusative.

opciones.texto: It does not govern any case because it always works as a conjunction.
opciones.explicacion: It is a preposition that determines the case of the nominal synthagma of the source.

bloques.frase: Den vorliegenden Dokumenten ___ seien die Vorwürfe unbegründet.

opciones.explicacion: Possession to the «Den vorliegenden Dokumenten» dative expresses «according to available documents».
«Wegen» rules genitive and expresses causality, not source attribution.
«Trotz» expresses concession («despite the»), not quote from documentary source.

bloques.pregunta: What does this official statement mean?
bloques.frase: Laut der Polizei sei der Fahrer unverletzt geblieben.

opciones.texto: According to the police, the driver was reportedly unharmed in the incident.
opciones.explicacion: «unverletzt geblieben» means he was not injured.

opciones.texto: The police arrested the driver for disobeying the traffic signs.
opciones.explicacion: The statement only refers to the unharmed physical state of the driver.

opciones.texto: The doctors stated that the driver needs urgent assistance at the hospital.
opciones.explicacion: «unverletzt» precisely indicates that he has no injuries.

bloques.frase: laut dem Bericht seien die Zahlen positiv
bloques.explicacion: combination of source formula and Konjunktiv I.

intro: In rigorous journalism and institutional reports it is crucial to separate the information **fuente** from the mentioned **afirmación**.
